name: Dependency Update Check
description: Scans configured dependency/security endpoints for outdated packages, patches, and breaking-change risks.
tagline: Reviews dependency update feeds for security patches, outdated packages, and risky upgrades.

ownedSettings.label: Dependency update check schedule
ownedSettings.description: Cron, model, prompt, and run parameters.

fields.label: Dependency and advisory endpoints
fields.helpText: One HTTP(S) endpoint per line. Endpoints can be native APIs, internal exports, webhooks, or JSON/text snapshots.

fields.label: Bearer token env vars
fields.helpText: Comma-separated environment variable names. The first variable with a value is used as a Bearer token.

fields.label: Context notes
fields.placeholder: Prioritize security updates, runtime dependencies, and packages used in production deploy paths. Flag likely breaking changes.
fields.helpText: Optional instructions, priorities, account names, or pasted context to include in every run.

fields.label: Publish report to Item Bus
fields.helpText: When enabled, each run publishes the report as a dev.dependency-report item.

routes.label: Deps
routes.description: Scans configured dependency/security endpoints for outdated packages, patches, and breaking-change risks.
